personality_one_liner: A cinematic, premium social voice experience with deep obsidian surfaces, rich gold and royal purple accents, and elegant translucent glass layers.

spacing.rule: Generous spacing. Use safe-area paddings. No cramped lists. Maintain structural hierarchy through intentional gaps.

do's: Apply to sticky headers, bottom tab bars, bottom-sheet drag handles.
Use on Room detail bottom action bar and chat overlay panel background.
Always layer a tinted base (rgba(18,18,18,0.75)) beneath the blur to guarantee text readability in dark mode.
dont's: Do not use on regular list rows, standard buttons, or form fields.
Do not stack more than 2 glass surfaces on a single screen.

screens.name: Splash

states.loading: Full-bleed abstract purple/gold texture background, central gold VoiceUp logo, subtle fade-in animation.

screens.layout: Full-screen layout using a background image (images.splash_bg) covered with a vertical dark gradient scrim. The logo sits centered. Safe area edges are respected.

screens.name: Onboarding
screens.purpose: Introduce the app's core social audio features to new users.
screens.layout: 3 full-bleed slides with distinct background imagery. Each uses a heavy gradient-to-dark scrim (top 0% -> bottom 80% surfaceInverse). Text and gold primary CTA are anchored in the bottom 30% thumb zone.

screens.name: Auth (Login / Register)
screens.purpose: User authentication via email and password.

states.error: Inline red text above CTA for validation/auth errors.

screens.layout: Single column form. Top typography header. Labels above inputs. Inputs use surfaceTertiary background. Primary 'Continue' CTA is sticky at the bottom inside KeyboardAvoidingView.

screens.name: Home / Discover
screens.purpose: Browse and join live voice rooms, or start a new one.

states.empty: Illustration of a microphone, 'No active rooms in this category', 'Start a Room' gold CTA.
states.error: Readable error message with a 'Retry' button centered.

screens.layout: Header with user avatar & notifications. Horizontal scrollable row for category chips (never wrap, use pill radius). A 2-column grid or large single-column list of live voice rooms. Room cards have image backgrounds with gradient scrims, host avatar, name, 'LIVE' badge, listener count, and tags. Floating action button (FAB) for 'Start a Room' in bottom right using glassmorphism.

screens.name: Room Detail
screens.purpose: The core live audio experience with grid of mic seats and interactive chat.

states.error: Toast or modal indicating connection failure with 'Leave' button.

screens.layout: Full-bleed with blurred room cover background. Top safe area: Room Name, ID, Host, Listeners count. Middle: Grid of 8 mic seats (1 at top center, 7 below in 2 rows). Each seat uses a circular avatar (or empty/locked placeholder), name tag, mic status icon, and pulsing ring when speaking. Bottom left: Overlay chat panel (max height ~30%) displaying system and user messages on a dark glass background. Bottom fixed action bar (glassmorphic): Mic toggle, raise-hand, gift (gold icon), chat input trigger, share, exit button.

screens.name: Profile
screens.purpose: Display user identity, stats, VIP status, and badges.

states.empty: Empty state illustration in the tabs for 'No Gifts' or 'No Badges'.

screens.layout: Large cover banner at top (abstract purple/gold). Avatar overlapping the banner with VIP frame. User Name, ID, Country. Chips for Level, Wealth, Charm underneath. Primary action row (Follow/Message or Edit Profile). A tabbed section below (Info, Gifts, Badges) stretching to the bottom.

screens.name: Wallet
screens.layout: Top section: High-contrast Gold/Purple gradient card showing Coin Balance, secondary card for Diamonds. Below: A 2-column grid of top-up packages (Price, Coin Amount, Bonus Badge). 'Transaction History' row leading to a list.

screens.name: Gifts Panel
screens.purpose: Bottom sheet to select and send virtual gifts to room participants.
screens.layout: Rendered via @gorhom/bottom-sheet. Glass/dark background. Top tab row (Popular, Luxury, VIP). Grid of gifts (using transparent 3D icons). Each gift card shows icon, coin price, rarity colored border when selected. Bottom sticky bar: Recipient selector, quantity, and 'Send' button.

screens.name: Messages & Chat
screens.layout: List of DMs with unread badges. Chat screen has header with user info, scrollable list of message bubbles, bottom sticky input area with mic and attach icons.

screens.name: Leaderboards
screens.purpose: Rank top users by wealth, charm, and gifting.
screens.layout: Top tabs for categories and timeframes. Top 3 users displayed in a podium layout (center #1 is larger with a gold crown, #2 and #3 on sides). The rest of the list follows below as standard rows with rank numbers.

screens.name: Notifications
screens.purpose: System alerts, new followers, and room invites.
screens.layout: Standard list layout with icon/avatar leading, message body, and timestamp trailing.

screens.name: Settings
screens.layout: Grouped list rows (surfaceSecondary) for Language, Theme, Privacy, Logout. Chevron trailing icons.

instructions_to_main_agent: Load 'Cairo' font from Google Fonts CDN to ensure excellent Arabic (RTL) and Latin (LTR) support.
RTL Support is critical: Use React Native's I18nManager.forceRTL(true) and layout attributes (marginStart/End instead of marginLeft/Right) so UI accurately mirrors for Arabic users.

Implement the Glass / Luxe Dark personality perfectly. Rely heavily on deep obsidian backgrounds (#0D0D0D / #121212) highlighted by #F5C542 (Gold) and #6A0DAD (Purple). Do not use solid white backgrounds.
The Room Detail screen is the heart of the app. Layout the 8 mic seats neatly (1 top center for host, 7 below). Implement smooth, bounded interactions for the bottom sheet and glass overlays.
For the Gifts Bottom Sheet, ensure a dark transparent overlay (rgba(0,0,0,0.6)) beneath the sheet to keep the focus on the gifts grid. Use the provided 3D isolated icons for realism.
Whenever overlaying text on images (like the Home Room Cards or Profile Banners), strictly enforce a vertical gradient-to-dark scrim (top 0% -> bottom 80%) to ensure WCAG AA readable text.
Avoid default system blue or purple gradients. Stick exactly to the brand primary and secondary hues provided in the JSON.
